name: Rancor, Adolescent

behaviors.name: Siege Monster
behaviors.description: The rancor deals double damage to objects and structures.

behaviors.name: Multiattack
behaviors.description: The rancor makes three attacks: two with its claws, and one with its bite.

behaviors.name: Claw
behaviors.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6+5) kinetic damage.

behaviors.name: Bite
behaviors.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 16 (2d10+5) kinetic damage.

behaviors.name: Throw Boulder
behaviors.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 60/240 ft., one target. Hit 21 (3d10 + 5) kinetic damage.

sectionText: Rancors are large carnivorous reptomammals native to the planet of Dathomir. They are commonly kept as pets by affluent, less-than-reputable types.
